summary.decision_summary: Millan’s Last Supper won by 44.7. Millan’s Last Supper left 52.5 lineup points on the table, while Squat left 42.1.
summary.historical_summary: Millan’s Last Supper is 4-5 against Squat across 9 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Millan’s Last Supper
summary.winner_reason: Millan’s Last Supper won by 44.7, led by a 18.6-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Derrick Henry (20.9) and Jared Goff (19.7).
summary.loser_reason: Squat could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 18.6 points. Saquon Barkley scored 1.0. A best legal lineup added 42.1, still short of the 44.7-point margin.
